thread:
maya: Quick sanity check before I hand off in ~30m. Saw a burst of model cold-start errors from the batch pool — noisy pagers. Thinking to: bump cold_start alert threshold, route non-critical customer dev alerts to #eng-oncall (no pager) for 1h. Anyone object?

tom: I'm around. can you paste the current alert config?

maya: current: `alerts.cold_start.rate >= 5 per min for 5m` firing to PagerDuty. proposal: raise to `>= 9 per min` and change route to eng-oncall-low for 60m. Also suppress `customer-dev-*` group alerts to avoid noisy duplicates.

sre_jordan: sounds reasonable for a short window. prefer route to #eng-oncall instead of eng-oncall-low so triage is visible but doesn't wake folks. +1 to 60m ttl.

claudia: agree with Jordan. FYI if this happens again we should consider caching warm pools or adding a lightweight readiness probe to reduce cold-start spikes.

maya: good call. I'll only change routing and ttl, not the escalation policy.

maya: @sre_jordan can you apply the change? paste command if handy and I'll approve.

sre_jordan: applying now. using admin-api:

```
curl -X POST https://ops-api.redwood.internal/alerts/routes/update \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $SRE_API_TOKEN' \
  -d '{"alert":"alerts.cold_start.rate","threshold":9,"window":"5m","route":"#eng-oncall","ttl_minutes":60}'
```

sre_jordan: also suppressing label `customer:dev` for 60m:

```
curl -X POST https://ops-api.redwood.internal/alerts/suppress \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $SRE_API_TOKEN' \
  -d '{"label":"customer:dev","ttl_minutes":60,"reason":"pre-handoff noise reduction"}'
```

oncall-bot: Change request received from sre_jordan. Deployment in progress... :gear:

deploy-bot: Route update completed: `alerts.cold_start.rate` -> #eng-oncall (ttl 60m). Suppression `customer:dev` applied (60m). Change-id: ch_20260315_3421

maya: thank you. I'll note in handoff: raised threshold, routed to #eng-oncall, customer-dev suppressed for 60m. Keep an eye for any missed customer-impact alerts; escalate if anything looks wrong. :thumbsup:

tom: noted. if we see degradation we'll revert and open a quick postmortem.

claudia: heading into handoff — ping me if anything pops. leaving the runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/cold-starts

maya: handoff done. thanks everyone.

sre_jordan: leaving the channel watch for next 20m then moving to background.

maya: last note — created a follow-up ticket to evaluate warm pool sizing so this is not a recurring change: https://issues.redwood.internal/RED-4123
